stats.notes: Figures from IPEDS, the US government's college data, for fall 2024 (admit rate 96.4%). No Common Data Set was found on umes.edu (site search and its Decision Science & Visualization pages), so no international split, GPA or residency data. UMES is test-optional and College Navigator reports no SAT/ACT percentiles. College Navigator shows about 2% of undergraduates from foreign countries (rounded).

cost.notes: College Navigator 2024-25 (tuition and fees, first-year full-time): in-state $9,076, out-of-state $20,122; books $1,250; on-campus food and housing $11,351; other expenses $5,000; total on campus out-of-state $37,723
